_comment: EN-default variant of config.example.json. Use this if your output_language is 'en' (Lemon8 / LinkedIn / X / Instagram, English audience). For zh-default (Xiaohongshu native), use config.example.json instead. Same schema, just EN-friendly defaults: persona placeholders are English, must_contain is ['Amazon'], forbidden_brands_in_copy doesn't include the original author's zh-only entries. Copy this file to ~/.config/amazon-xhs-poster/config.json (or set XHS_AMAZON_CONFIG=<path>) and fill in your persona.

persona.brand_cn: REPLACE_ME — your account display name (e.g. 'Vincent in Seattle')
persona.identity: REPLACE_ME — one-line operator backstory (e.g. '10-year Amazon seller, Seattle WA')
persona.voice: restrained, practical, no chicken-soup fluff — like a lead operator running a team

_output_language_help: en = English output (default for Lemon8 / LinkedIn / X / Instagram). zh = Chinese output (use config.example.json for that). Switching output_language auto-flips must_contain / cta_tokens / decision_verbs to language-appropriate defaults below — but you can override any of those explicitly.
_platform_help: Default 'xiaohongshu' so the post-en.example.json (XHS-shaped EN example) validates against this config out-of-the-box. EN users on a different platform: change this to 'lemon8' / 'linkedin' / 'x' / 'instagram' AND raise title_constraints.max_chars to match (default 20 is the XHS soft cap; LinkedIn / X / IG accept much longer titles). See references/platforms.md.
_title_help: 20 chars is the Xiaohongshu soft cap. Increase for other platforms: lemon8 → 30, linkedin / x / instagram → 60+. The validator hard-fails titles longer than max_chars.
_cta_tokens_help: Optional override. EN default: ['like', 'save', 'follow', 'comment', 'share', 'subscribe']. ZH default: ['点赞', '收藏', '关注', '不迷路', '评论']. Leave null to use language default.
_decision_verbs_help: Optional override for the ai-workflow card 5 decision-verb soft-warn. EN default: ['decide', 'switch', 'pause', 'stop', 'increase budget', 'remove', 'select', 'transfer', 'rebuild', 'cut', 'promote', 'keep', 'kill']. ZH default: ['决定', '判断', '换', '停', '加预算', '下架', '挑选', '暂停', '转移', '重组', '砍', '上架', '留'].
_forbidden_brands_help: Replace these placeholders with names of your internal tools, products, or deprecated brands that you specifically don't want leaking into public copy. The validator hard-fails if any of these tokens appear in the post.
_gated_sources_help: Optional research pipeline. When enabled, fetch-gated.mjs walks 6 sources daily and writes <drafts_root>/<DATE>/research/gated-signal.md. RISK: automating logged-in access (X / LinkedIn) may violate ToS. Read references/gated-sources.md before enabling.

x._handle_help: X usernames cap at 15 chars. Verify each handle exists at x.com before adding.

linkedin._help: Copy the slug from linkedin.com/in/<slug>/. Note: vanity slug isn't always the canonical (Andy Jassy is /in/andy-jassy-8b1615/, not /in/andyjassy/).

gated_sources._wearesellers_help: Chinese-language seller community. EN users may prefer to disable since the fetched content is in Chinese.
gated_sources._bds_help: billiondollarsellers.com paid newsletter. Default disabled — flip to true ONLY if you have a subscription.
gated_sources._walmart_help: PUBLIC. corporate.walmart.com/news.sitemap.xml is dated XML; fetcher takes top N by lastmod and Playwright-extracts body.
gated_sources._youtube_help: PUBLIC. RSS endpoint returns 404 from many regions; fetcher uses Playwright via CDP to scrape /@<handle>/videos.
